analysis.grouped_bootstrap_method: cluster resampling with replacement; eICU by patient-safe hospital cluster and MIMIC-III/MIMIC-IV by subject_key
analysis.cross_validated_ci_note: Out-of-fold recalibration maps were held fixed during cluster bootstrap resampling; intervals are conditional on the fitted maps and do not include recalibration-map estimation variance.
analysis.patient_safe_hospital_clusters: Connected components of the eICU patient-hospital graph. Hospitals sharing any patient are held out together, so no patient contributes to both training and test folds.
analysis.sign_convention: original model positive direction; no absolute values
analysis.calibration_metric_note: Raw calibration slope/intercept calibrate the original probability; OOF-recalibrated calibration slope/intercept calibrate the cross-fitted recalibrated probability. They are not the affine-map coefficients.
analysis.cross_model_calibration_comparison_note: All transported models were trained on the same five-class development outcome and then collapsed to the shared four-class external scale. Cross-model calibration differences still compare complete modeling pipelines rather than graph structure alone. Within-model raw versus OOF-recalibrated comparisons are the primary calibration evidence.
analysis.common3_harmonization_note: Class 1 is a pragmatic harmonization. It combines non-home post-acute and other care categories that are not construct-identical across databases.

patient_safe_hospital_clustering.split_rule: connected components of the patient-hospital graph; every held-out hospital cluster is disjoint from training patients
